lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a crowdsourced geographic database maintained by volunteer contributors. The dataset represents approximately 1.2 million mapped buildings with an average data age of 4 years and 5% coverage estimated through AI-mapping validation. Data are provided in multiple standard geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for interoperability.
